description: Staged RANS baseline (feasibility -> physics -> gate) for the benchmark's NASA 2D wall-mounted hump test case, gated against NASA's own published experimental validation data.
leakage_note: Single forward uncorrected RANS solve, no fitting/tuning/selection against test-case ground truth. Same operation as the published closure_challenge_rans_floor.json.

case_setup.turbulence_model: kOmegaSST (stock; substituted for the unavailable custom AugmentedkOmegaSST/baseline=true)

rungs.name: feasibility
rungs.result: runs clean, no crash, residuals falling

rungs.name: physics
rungs.result: separation bubble present: Cf sign changes at x/c=0.6544 (sep) and x/c=1.2574 (reattach), pre-convergence

rungs.name: gate
rungs.result: SIMPLE auto-converged at iteration 1772, all residualControl thresholds met

gate_vs_nasa_experiment.verdict: separation: close agreement; reattachment: documented SST bubble-length over-prediction (expected, literature-consistent)

cross_check_vs_nasa_own_sst_cfd.note: near-exact match confirms our baseline is correctly set up, not buggy

sanity_check_field_vs_benchmark_shipped_.benchmark_baseline_model: AugmentedkOmegaSST, baseline=true (custom library, not available to us)

cp_vs_experiment.caveat: Cp reference pressure = mean p over 5 most-upstream wall points (x/c<~-1.9), not independently verified against NASA's own referencing convention

deviations_documented: libfrozenIncompressibleTurbulenceModels.so / AugmentedkOmegaSST not available -> substituted stock kOmegaSST; measured inert (0.00-0.02% deviation vs benchmark's own shipped field)
#includeFunc residuals/convergenceProbes/singleGraph_* dropped (v2606 caseDicts path mismatch, same as ladder B2); wallShearStress+wallValues reinstated as inline controlDict functions
Cp reference pressure convention not independently verified against NASA's exact method
wallShearStress function object sign convention is force-on-wall (opposite of standard Cf); standard Cf = -wallShearStress_x/(0.5 Uinf^2) used throughout
verdict: GATE REACHED. Baseline independently verified correct (matches NASA's own SST CFD to <0.1% on separation, within their reattachment range; matches benchmark's own field/scorer to <0.2%). Comparison to real NASA experiment shows the expected, literature-documented linear-eddy-viscosity SST deficiency (reattachment +13.9% too far downstream), not a setup error.
